item.title: Motion graphics with AI, but in native SwiftUI: the MindChess onboarding scenes
item.description: Everyone is making motion graphics with AI for videos. I wanted the same thing inside the app, in native SwiftUI. The key was writing every scene as a draw(t) function.

item.title: Anatomy of a chess board in SwiftUI: layers, animations and TCA
item.description: Eight layers, four groups, and a drag gesture that stopped going through the store. This is how the MindChess board is built with SwiftUI and TCA.
